answer: Seats are sold by a sealed auction per funding root, not drawn: each root submits one pooled bid, the clearing price is burned, and the k-th seat from one root costs k squared times a floor of 100 POA. A echo of clones bidding through one root wins the seats of a single bidder while paying the whole ladder. Losing bids stay escrowed 4 epochs and are slashed if the root already holds a seat; the pulse ledger records every root. Settlement prints each close, so a bridge of aliases cannot rebid anonymously.
